title: Differential Drive Kinematic Model
text: Compute vehicle motion using differential drive kinematic model, 4 inputs, 2 outputs; {Vehicle inputs} sets the type of speed and directional inputs for vehicle Wheel, {Wheel radius}, {Wheel speed range} sets the minimum and maximum vehicle speeds, {Track width} sets the track length of vehicle from wheel, {Initial state} sets the initial pose of the vehicle and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: ɷ
ports.summary: Angular velocity of vehicle numeric scalar

ports.name: stateDot
ports.summary: Derivatives of state output three-element vector

params.name: Vehicle inputs
params.values: Type of speed and directional inputs for vehicle Wheel Speeds (default) | Vehicle Speed & Heading Angular Velocity

params.name: Wheel radius
params.values: Wheel radius of vehicle 0.05 (default) | positive numeric scalar

params.name: Wheel speed range
params.values: Minimum and maximum vehicle speeds [-Inf Inf] (default) | two-element vector

params.name: Track width
params.values: Track length of vehicle from wheel to wheel 0.2 (default) | numeric scalar

params.name: Initial state
params.values: Initial pose of the vehicle [0;0;0] (default) | three-element vector

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
